purpose: Concept + age -> teaching method, as structured data (converted from teaching_strategy.md v1.0 per creator feedback that AI retrieves structured data more reliably than prose tables).

methods.reasoning: One-step cause-effect only; can't hold multi-step reasoning
methods.story_implication: Short conflict, single clear action, concept word repeated 2-3 times in context

methods.reasoning: Two-step cause-effect, mild internal conflict tolerable
methods.story_implication: Standard 5-beat structure works directly; keep the lesson to one clear takeaway

methods.reasoning: Can handle a real, if small, moral cost to the right choice
methods.story_implication: Add a closing reflection beat (ending_styles.json's reflection_question style) - the story alone isn't enough at this age, naming the why briefly reinforces it

selection_procedure: 1. Read the target age from the resolved topic's age_range field.
2. Look up the matching method row by age_band.
3. Cross-reference the concept package's definition_by_age field for exact wording - never write a fresh definition.
4. Pass the selected method to story_prompt.md as a beat-structure constraint, not a rewrite of the 5-beat template - only pacing and reflection-beat presence vary by age.
